svg.aria-label: Rib movements in inspiration: pump handle and bucket handle — 吸气时肋骨的运动：泵柄与桶柄

text.aria-label: Rib movements in inspiration: pump handle and bucket handle — 吸气时肋骨的运动：泵柄与桶柄
text.tspan: Rib movements in inspiration: pump handle and bucket handle
吸气时肋骨的运动：泵柄与桶柄

text.aria-label: A. Pump handle: ribs 2–6 (right lateral view) — A. 泵柄运动：第 2–6 肋（右侧面观）
text.tspan: A. Pump handle: ribs 2–6 (right lateral view)
A. 泵柄运动：第 2–6 肋（右侧面观）

text.aria-label: Axis: nearly side to side, through the two posterior joints — 轴：接近左右方向，穿过后方两个关节
text.tspan: Axis: nearly side to side, through the two posterior joints
轴：接近左右方向，穿过后方两个关节

text.aria-label: Front ends and sternum move up and forward — 肋骨前端和胸骨向前上方抬起
text.tspan: Front ends and sternum move up and forward
肋骨前端和胸骨向前上方抬起

text.aria-label: Front-to-back diameter increases — 前后径增大
text.tspan: Front-to-back diameter increases
前后径增大

text.aria-label: B. Bucket handle: ribs 7–10 (anterior view) — B. 桶柄运动：第 7–10 肋（前面观）
text.tspan: B. Bucket handle: ribs 7–10 (anterior view)
B. 桶柄运动：第 7–10 肋（前面观）

text.aria-label: Dashed lines = axis: nearly front to back, from the spine to the front of the rib — 虚线 = 轴：接近前后方向，从脊柱到肋骨前端
text.tspan: Dashed lines = axis: nearly front to back, from the spine to the front of the rib
虚线 = 轴：接近前后方向，从脊柱到肋骨前端

text.aria-label: The middle of each rib moves up and out — 肋骨中段向外上方抬起
text.tspan: The middle of each rib moves up and out
肋骨中段向外上方抬起

text.aria-label: Side-to-side diameter increases — 左右径增大
text.tspan: Side-to-side diameter increases
左右径增大

text.aria-label: Highlighted ribs are the ones named for each movement. Arrows show the direction of movement in inspiration; they are not to scale. — 着色的肋骨是各运动对应的肋。箭头表示吸气时的运动方向，不按比例。
text.tspan: Highlighted ribs are the ones named for each movement. Arrows show the direction of movement in inspiration; they are not to scale.
着色的肋骨是各运动对应的肋。箭头表示吸气时的运动方向，不按比例。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
